choice.title: Markdown Viewer
choice.description: The app and its Quick Look extension (spacebar previews in Finder). Installed in /Applications.

choice.title: Open .md files with Markdown Viewer
choice.description: Makes Markdown Viewer the default app for .md, .markdown, .mdown, and .mkd files.

choice.title: Use Markdown Viewer for Quick Look previews
choice.description: If another app's Quick Look extension currently handles Markdown files (for example QLMarkdown), this makes Markdown Viewer's extension the one Finder uses when you press Space. You can change this later in System Settings > General > Login Items & Extensions > Extensions > Quick Look.

choice.title: Mermaid Quick Look helper
choice.description: Renders Mermaid diagrams live in Quick Look previews, even for files never opened in the app. Adds a background item (visible under System Settings > Login Items) that is started on demand by macOS and quits after 45 seconds of inactivity.
